title: Rigid Body Stacking & Toppling
prompt:
Create a 3D rigid body stacking and toppling simulation using Three.js. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background color 0x1a1a2e.
- PerspectiveCamera at (15, 12, 15), looking at (0, 5, 0).
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x404060) and directional light (0xffffff, intensity 1.0) at (10, 20, 5) with castShadow=true.
- A ground plane at y=0, size 30x30, color 0x333344, receiveShadow=true.

## Physics System (implement from scratch, no external physics engine)
- Gravity: g = 9.81 m/s² downward.
- Each box is a rigid body with: position, velocity, angularVelocity (simplified to y-axis only), mass=1.
- Collision detection: AABB overlap test between boxes and between boxes and ground.
- Ground collision: when box bottom <= 0, set y so bottom=0, reflect vy with restitution=0.3, apply friction to vx/vz (multiply by 0.8).
- Box-box collision: when two AABBs overlap, push them apart along the minimum penetration axis, exchange velocity components along that axis (simplified elastic collision).
- Resting contact: when |vy| < 0.1 and box is touching ground or another box, set vy=0 (resting state).

## Initial Stack
- Create a tower of 6 boxes stacked vertically at x=0, z=0. Each box is 2x2x2. Bottom box at y=1, next at y=3, etc.
- Each box has a different color (use a preset palette of 6 colors).

## Interactions
- Press 'F' to apply a horizontal impulse force (vx += 8) to the top box of the stack, causing the tower to topple.
- Press 'A' to add a new box (max 15) dropping from y=20 at random x in [-3,3], z in [-3,3].
- Press 'R' to reset to initial 6-box stack.
- Press Space to toggle pause/play (starts paused).
- Slider (id='slider-restitution', range 0.0 to 1.0, step 0.05, default 0.3) to adjust restitution.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Box count (id='hud-boxes')
- Toppled status (id='hud-toppled'): 'Yes' or 'No' (toppled = any box has fallen to ground that was originally stacked)
- Resting count (id='hud-resting'): number of boxes in resting state
- Max height (id='hud-maxheight'): highest box y position, 1 decimal
- Collision count (id='hud-collisions'): total collisions detected
- Paused (id='hud-paused'): 'Paused' or 'Running'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `boxCount`: number
- `isToppled`: boolean
- `restingCount`: number
- `maxHeight`: number (rounded to 2 decimals)
- `collisionCount`: number
- `isPaused`: boolean
- `restitution`: number
- `centerOfMass`: {x, y, z} (rounded to 2 decimals)
- `totalKineticEnergy`: number (sum of 0.5*m*v^2 for all boxes, rounded to 3 decimals)
- `frameCount`: number
- `boxesValid`: boolean (no NaN positions)

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: Boxes must not penetrate the ground (y >= box_half_height). Stacked boxes must remain stable when no force is applied. Kinetic energy must decrease over time due to restitution < 1. After toppling impulse, at least one box must change position significantly. Resting contact must prevent jitter (vy < 0.1 threshold). No NaN in any box position or velocity.
